cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Tell me you understand why six weeks of silence hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. For me, the silence didn't come with a repair notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Can you understand why I kept rewriting a message you'd never answered, trying to become easier to reply to?
